image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a dark, textured rocky substrate. The subject displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping, pale greenish-white calcareous plates. These plates are surrounded by a rough, brownish-grey leathery girdle (mantle). The image focuses on the dorsal side; the ventral foot is not visible as the animal is adhered to the rock.
